title: This year's program
description: This is the program for Kjemidagen 2026. We are looking forward to a great day with exciting events and activities!
opening_desc: This is the official opening of Kjemidagen, featuring entertainment and the chance to win a range of exciting prizes.
stands_desc: This is a great opportunity to meet relevant employers and ask them the questions you’ve been wanting to ask. The company stands are open to all students, regardless of year of study or field of study.
job_marathon_desc: Jobbmarathon is an event where companies have the opportunity to present any summer jobs, graduate, trainee, or permanent positions they are advertising. Each company gets 3–4 minutes to present itself. Our experience has shown that this event has received very positive feedback from both students and companies, and we strongly recommend participating.
banquet_desc: In the evening, a banquet will be arranged with company representatives and 4th and 5th year students. The banquet is an important part of Kjemidagen, and a great opportunity for companies to get to know our students better.
cv_photo_desc: This is a unique opportunity to have a professional portrait photo taken for your CV.
mingle_desc: The networking evening is intended to be a low-threshold meeting place for students and companies. This year it will be held at Lager 11 and will include food service and a quiz.
speed_interview_desc: Speed interviews are an exciting opportunity for both students and companies to get to know each other better. Here, you have the chance to talk to companies one-on-one and present yourself in the best possible way.
